name: m2-hoh-two-children
computation: Head of household filer, born 1988-06-10 (age 38 in 2026, not a senior, not blind, not a dependent), unmarried, paid more than half the cost of keeping up the home in 2026. Two dependents, each Child, lived with the filer all of 2026, valid Social Security numbers: Ava Sample born 2018-02-14 (age 8 at year end) and Ben Sample born 2021-09-30 (age 5 at year end); $4,800.00 of work-related care paid for Ben only. One W-2: box1 wages $38,000.00, box2 federal withholding $1,600.00, box3 Social Security wages $38,000.00, box4 Social Security tax withheld $2,356.00 (6.2% of $38,000), box5 Medicare wages $38,000.00, box6 Medicare tax withheld $551.00 (1.45% of $38,000). No other income, adjustments, itemized deductions, other credits, other taxes or estimated payments. Household eligibility (family()/household() in src/federal_rules.rs): both children are related (Child), lived with the filer all of 2026 (365 days >= 183) and are under 19 at year end, so both are qualifying-child dependents; qualifying_head and paid_over_half_home are both true, so the head-of-household status is valid. Form 1040 line 1a wages = $38,000.00 (the single W-2 box 1; no other wage documents). Line 9 total income = $38,000.00 (no interest, dividends or other income). Line 10 adjustments = $0.00. Line 11a/11b AGI = $38,000.00. Line 12e standard deduction: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 Table 8 2026 head-of-household base amount is $24,150 (standard_base() in src/federal_rules.rs); the filer is not claimable as a dependent, not 65 or older and not blind, so no additional amount is added: $24,150.00. Line 15 taxable income = $38,000.00 - $24,150.00 = $13,850.00. Line 16 tax: the 2026 draft Tax Table (tests/fixtures/irs-tax-table-2026.csv) row '13850,13900,1417,1388,1417,1388' covers taxable income at least $13,850 but less than $13,900; the head-of-household column (index 5, per the file header and draft_2026_table_tax() in src/tests/mod.rs) gives $1,388.00. Line 17 AMT/repayments = $0.00. Line 18 income tax before credits = $1,388.00. Schedule 8812 (forms/schedule_8812.rs): age(birth_date) = 2026 - birth_year, so Ava's age is 2026-2018=8 and Ben's is 2026-2021=5; both are under 17, dependency children with valid SSNs, so children=2 and other_dependents=0. Line 12 potential = 2 x $2,200 - phaseout = $4,400.00 (MAGI $38,000 is far under the $200,000 head-of-household phaseout threshold, so no reduction). Line 18a earned income = $38,000.00. Refundable limit (line 18a-20) = 15% x ($38,000 - $2,500) = 15% x $35,500 = $5,325.00. ACTC ceiling (fewer than 3 children, so only the earned-income test applies) = min($1,700 x 2 = $3,400.00, $5,325.00) = $3,400.00. Form 2441 Part II (forms/form_2441.rs): both children are care-credit qualifying persons -- each is a dependency child, a U.S. citizen/resident and born after January 1, 2013 (the family() care_person test) -- so care_people = 2 even though the $4,800.00 of expenses was paid only for Ben (the two-person ceiling applies even if expenses were paid for only one person). Line 3 ceiling for 2+ qualifying persons is $6,000; expenses $4,800.00 are under the ceiling, so care_cost (line 3) = $4,800.00 (no employer benefits to exclude). Line 4 taxpayer earned income = $38,000.00; the return is not joint, so line 6 = min($4,800.00, $38,000.00) = $4,800.00. Line 7 AGI = $38,000.00. Line 8 rate (care_rate() in forms/form_2441.rs, the 2026 P.L. 119-21 phase-down): ceiling($38,000-$15,000, $2,000) = ceiling($23,000, $2,000) = 12, so 50% - 12% = 38%, and max(35%, 38%) = 38%; ceiling($38,000-$75,000, $2,000) = 0 (AGI below $75,000), so the final rate is max(20%, 38% - 0%) = 38%. Line 9a = $4,800.00 x 38% = $1,824.00 (no line 9b prior-year care; line 9c = $1,824.00). Credit Limit Worksheet ordering (income_tax.rs PersonalCreditPotentials::limit, matching the fetched 2026 draft i2441--dft.pdf/i1040s8 Worksheet A/B ordering): the nonrefundable care credit (Schedule 3 line 2 / Form 2441 line 11) is drawn from the $1,388.00 of available tax before the nonrefundable child credit, so line 11 = min($1,388.00, $1,824.00) = $1,388.00, leaving $0.00 of tax capacity for the nonrefundable child credit. Schedule 8812 line 14 (Form 1040 line 19) = $0.00. Schedule 8812 line 27 (Form 1040 line 28) = min($4,400.00 unused potential, $3,400.00 earned-income ceiling) = $3,400.00. Form 1040 line 19 (child and other-dependent credits) = $0.00. Line 20 (other nonrefundable credits: Schedule 3 line 2, the Form 2441 credit; no other nonrefundable credit applies) = $1,388.00. Line 21 total nonrefundable credits = $1,388.00. Line 22 = $1,388.00 - $1,388.00 = $0.00. Line 23 additional taxes = $0.00 (no self-employment, Additional Medicare, NIIT or other Schedule 2 Part II tax; AGI is far below every additional-tax threshold). Line 24a total tax = $0.00 + $0.00 = $0.00. Schedule EIC, two children (forms/schedule_eic.rs; tests/fixtures/irs-eic-2026-draft.csv): earned income $38,000.00 equals AGI $38,000.00 (no other income), so the earned-income and AGI lookups are the same row and the 'take the lower' step changes nothing. Row '38000,38050,0,2168,4339,5254,0,3330,5870,6785' covers at least $38,000 but less than $38,050; the two-children non-joint column (single_2, the 5th field) gives $4,339.00. Investment income = $0.00, well under the $12,200 Pub 596 Worksheet 1 limit. Line 27a earned income credit = $4,339.00. Line 25a W-2 withholding = $1,600.00 (box 2; no 25b/25c withholding source). Line 26 estimated payments = $0.00. Line 28 additional child tax credit = $3,400.00 (from Schedule 8812 above). Lines 29-31 = $0.00 (no education, adoption or other payments). Line 33 total payments and refundable credits = $1,600.00 (25d) + $4,339.00 (27a) + $3,400.00 (28) = $9,339.00. Line 34 overpayment = max($9,339.00 - $0.00, 0) = $9,339.00 (a refund; line 37 balance due is $0.00 and is not a separate expected line here). This fact pattern touches the M2 fixture's 20-field information path : (1) filing status Head of household, (2) the home-cost checkbox, (3) whether anyone is supported, (4) the filer's first name, (5) last name and (6) birth date, Ava's (7) first name, (8) last name and (9) birth date, Ben's (10) first name, (11) last name and (12) birth date, (13) the care choice for Ben and (14) its amount, and W-2 (15) box 1, (16) box 2, (17) box 3, (18) box 4, (19) box 5 and (20) box 6.
